<function name="IsTakingScreenshot" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Lets you know when a screenshot is being taken during rendering hooks.

This is useful to hide certain visual elements from screenshots, such as debug overlays, helper objects, etc.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<added>2025.12.01</added>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Returns `true` when a screenshot is being taken.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
